name: Vex
title: the Gloomist

Q.name: Mistral Bolt
Q.description: Vex launches a wave of mist that deals 70/115/160/205/250 + 0.7×AP magic damage. After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster. Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.
Q.summary: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.

W.name: Personal Space
W.description: Vex gains 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.75×AP Shield for 2.5 seconds and emits a shockwave that deals 80/120/160/200/240 + 0.3×AP magic damage. Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.
W.summary: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.

E.name: Looming Darkness
E.description: Vex commands Shadow to fly to a location, increasing in size as it travels. Upon arriving, it deals 50/70/90/110/130 + 0.4/0.45/0.5/0.55/0.6×AP magic damage and Slows by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2 seconds. Killing an enemy with this ability reduces Doom'n Gloom's Cooldown by 10%. Applies Gloom to enemies hit.
E.summary: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.

R.name: Shadow Surge
R.description: Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing @spell.VexR:RDamageCalc@ magic damage and marking the first enemy champion hit for 4 seconds. Recast: Dash to the marked champion, dealing @spell.VexR:RecastDamageCalc@ magic damage on arrival. If the marked champion dies within @spell.VexR:TakedownWindow@ seconds of taking damage from this Ability, its Cooldown is temporarily reset.
R.summary: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash to them and deal damage.

Passive.name: Doom 'n Gloom
Passive.description: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.
Passive.summary: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Burst mage who punishes dashes: her empowered passive fears and interrupts dashes, and enemies that dash near her get marked. Wins with short-range burst and an R dash that resets on takedowns.
strengths: Empowered passive makes her next ability fear and interrupt dashes
Enemies that dash near her get Gloom: bonus damage and shorter passive cooldown
R resets on takedown: chains kills
weaknesses: Short range compared to most mages
Fear depends on passive being up
Weak to long-range poke mages and champions without dashes

curve.items: strong – first AP burst item (Luden's or Stormsurge)

Passive.notes: Periodically empowers her next basic ability to fear and interrupt dashes; dashing enemies get Gloom.

Q.notes: Mist wave that speeds up after a delay.

E.notes: Shadow flies to a location: damage, slow, applies Gloom.

R.notes: Shadow surge marks first champion; recast dashes to them. Resets on takedown.

profile.windowAgainst: Passive used (no fear): all-in or dash in then. Poke from outside her range.
